description: Open-source Electron music player aggregating multiple online music sources
##: Uses the win_x64 green 7z build; the Setup.exe installers are not used.
checkver targets the GitHub API to avoid scraping the releases HTML page.
autoupdate.hash is omitted so Scoop reads the asset digest from the GitHub API.
notes: Data is stored under %APPDATA%/lx-music-desktop and survives Scoop updates.
